svg.title: flowchart diagram
svg.desc: A flowchart diagram with 18 nodes and 23 edges. Flowing top to bottom. Key nodes: start, Idle, Starting. Key relationships: start points to Idle; Idle points to Space down / tap Space; Space down / tap Space points to Starting. Layout spans 1204 by 2036 units with 18 rendered node boxes and 23 routed edge paths.

g.title: Idle points to Space down / tap Space
Space down / tap Space points to Starting
Starting points to Space up, focus lost
Space up, focus lost points to Releasing
Recording points to Space up, focus lost / tap Space
Space up, focus lost / tap Space points to Stopping
Releasing points to opened / tap Space
opened / tap Space points to Stopping
Settling points to opened / tap Space
opened / tap Space points to Stopping
